content_html:
If you’re searching on Google for terms like “Peru itinerary 10 days,” “Peru 7 day itinerary,” “Peru all-inclusive tour,” or “best route for Machu Picchu,” here you’ll find the most popular and best-selling routes for 2026.

Discover the most complete, organized, and easy-to-book routes to experience the very best of Peru.

1 Classic Route: Lima + Cusco + Machu Picchu (7 Days)
Peru 7 day itinerary / Peru 1 week itinerary

Ideal for:
First-time visitors to Peru

High conversion because it includes:

  • City tour in Lima
  • Domestic flight to Cusco
  • Sacred Valley tour
  • Train + entrance ticket to Machu Picchu
  • Hotels and airport transfers

This is the most requested route and the easiest to sell as a complete package.

2 Adventure Route: Lima + Paracas + Huacachina + Cusco (8–10 Days)


Peru 10 day itinerary / Complete Peru travel route

Includes:

  • Ballestas Islands tour
  • Sandboarding in Huacachina
  • Nazca Lines flight experience
  • Cusco + Machu Picchu

Excellent for selling combined experiences and full travel packages.

3 Southern Andes Route: Arequipa + Colca + Puno + Cusco (10–12 Days)

Includes:

  • Colca Canyon
  • Lake Titicaca
  • Rainbow Mountain
  • Machu Picchu

Premium route → Higher average booking value and more profitable.

4 Relax + Culture Route: Northern Beaches + Cusco (9 Days)
Peru beaches + Machu Picchu itinerary

Ideal for:
Travelers looking for culture + relaxation

Combines stunning beaches with the historical wonder of Machu Picchu.

5 Nature Route: Amazon + Cusco (8 Days)
Amazon Peru + Machu Picchu tour

Includes:

  • Jungle lodge stay
  • Night rainforest excursions
  • Cusco and Machu Picchu

Perfect for travelers seeking nature, adventure, and culture in one unforgettable trip.

How to Make These Routes More Sellable

Use strategic, high-intent titles like:

“Peru 10 Day Itinerary: Complete Guide + 2026 Prices”
“Best Route to Travel to Peru for First-Time Visitors”
“How Much Does It Cost to Travel to Peru for 7, 10 or 15 Days?”
“Peru All-Inclusive Tour: Updated 2026 Deals”

Travel to Peru with GT Peru Travel without worrying about a thing.
We include carefully selected hotels, guided tours, and guaranteed Machu Picchu entry.

Book today before 2026 prices increase and availability sells out.
